title: Wire an executable pulse instrument
scenario: V13; I20 shared preview and caller-policy consumer check.
host: macOS 27.2.1 arm64, headless Chrome 158.0.8127.37, 1160 × 890 CSS pixels
backend: Loopback Python 3.14.7; Moxi PlotSpec and Figure SVG reference renderer
fixture: Signal Playground synthetic 04-pulse.wav, first 1024 PCM samples, single local operator
reproduce: From the repository root run node examples/visual-instrument/check.cjs /tmp/v13-captures with locally installed Chrome and puppeteer-core. See the example README for setup. The check starts a fresh loopback server on an ephemeral port, drives the panel and asserts the results.

slides.caption: Disconnected instrument
slides.action: Open a fresh server and page.
slides.expected: Five fixed nodes are present. No wires, trace or recording exist.

slides.caption: Recorded filter state
slides.action: Tab through both port selects and Connect to construct the four wires. Record, select the Low-pass probe and press End on the block slider.
slides.expected: All four edges appear. The recorder retains 32 rows and the last probe time is 23.220 ms.

slides.caption: Compare the coefficient edit
slides.action: Set the coefficient to 0.04 and press P with focus on a button.
slides.expected: Orange previews the edit against the teal 0.25 recording. The two traces differ.

slides.caption: Inspect a clock mismatch
slides.action: Press Escape, select 22050 and try Record.
slides.expected: Cancellation restores the 0.25 trace. The status identifies both incompatible rates.

slides.caption: Reject a sample-to-feature wire
slides.action: Return to 44100 and connect WAV source to Recorder.
slides.expected: The status rejects the wire. The recorder still receives Block RMS.

slides.caption: Interrupt the RMS node
slides.action: Check Fail block 7 and press Record.
slides.expected: The run stops at block 7. Downloadable recording data and filter probe still match the previous successful run.

slides.caption: Record after clearing the fault
slides.action: Uncheck the fault, set the coefficient to 0.04 and press Record.
slides.expected: The recorder replaces its 32 rows with the recovered run. The automated check then undoes it and reloads to verify the original rows.
